clinical_intent: I am managing a 32-year-old female with a recurrent cervical cancer (Stage IIIB) after radical hysterectomy and adjuvant chemoradiation (50.4 Gy EBRT + cisplatin + 30 Gy brachytherapy boost completed 10 months ago). The recurrence is a 4 cm central pelvic mass with bladder invasion causing hematuria. She has bilateral hydronephrosis requiring nephrostomy tubes. Her performance status is ECOG 2. Her creatinine is 2.8 (baseline 0.8). She has lost 15 kg in the past 3 months. Given the extensive prior radiation, poor performance status, and renal impairment, should I recommend re-irradiation, systemic therapy, or best supportive care? What systemic options exist?
